name: couplewar
description: CoupleWar — PWA party game multi-écrans, couple vs couple, temps réel.

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:client"
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @couplewar/shared && npm run test -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
